content: Beware the barrenness of a frantically busy life.
author: Ancient Greek Proverbs
explanation: We fill our days with back-to-back appointments, endless emails, and frantic tasks, wearing exhaustion as a badge of honor. But beneath the noisy blur of motion lies a terrifying desert of the soul: zero contemplation, zero deep love, and zero sacred presence. Slow down.
practicalInsight: Leave a 30-minute block of empty white space on your calendar today. Do nothing; simply be.
reflectionPrompt: Are you using manic busyness to run away from having to sit quietly with yourself?
